name: Austria
summary: Alpine republic in Central Europe utilizing extensive high-head and run-of-river hydroelectric resources along the Danube and Inn rivers to maintain one of Europe's cleanest electricity grids.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.88x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Graz and Klagenfurt alpine basins monitor localized winter inversion particulate trapping.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; Alpine glacier mass balance loss accelerated to record rates.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Alpine warming amplification: +0.48 °C per decade over trailing 30-year window (1994-2023).

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.2% share of global fossil emissions; zero domestic coal-fired electricity generation.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Industrial energy demand in Linz and transport transit across Alpine corridors sustain per capita footprint.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Alpine spruce and larch protective mountain forests covering ~39,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Alpine hydro provided 61.2%, onshore wind 13.8%, solar PV 7.8%, and bioenergy 4.6% of domestic power.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 109 people/km²; urban population fraction is 59.2%.
